description: This file defines the 'ContentTop' class, a controller component in the OpenCart MVC framework responsible for assembling and rendering the 'content_top' section of a webpage. It loads necessary models, determines the layout based on route and request parameters, fetches modules associated with the layout, and renders the view template.

classes.name: ContentTop
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating the 'content_top' section of the webpage.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads models, determines route and layout, fetches modules, and renders the 'content_top' view with assembled data.
